//: CONFIG-AS-CODE FOR THE NIGHTLY BACKUP CRON SERVICE.
Not railway.json — that one is the API service, and a Railway project's
services each read their own config path (Settings -> Config-as-code).
Point the backup service at 'railway.backup.json' and it builds the right
Dockerfile with the right schedule; leave it unset and it would build the
API's Dockerfile and run as an always-on web service, which is how you get
a second copy of the API billed by the hour and still no backups.
THE CRON SCHEDULE IS THE PART THAT WAS MISSING. Everything else in this
file existed as a Dockerfile and a script; what did not exist was anything
that ran them. 15 3 * * * is 03:15 UTC daily. Railway runs a cron service
to completion on that schedule instead of keeping it up, so it is billed
for the ~40 seconds it takes rather than for 24 hours.
restartPolicyType is NEVER on purpose. A failed backup has already emailed
ESCALATION_EMAIL and written a FAILED row to BackupRun; restarting it would
send the same alert three more times at 3am for a cause that is not going
to resolve itself in ten seconds. Tomorrow's run is the retry.
Environment variables are NOT here and cannot be: they are secrets. See
